og.og:description: Job Openings Career Opportunities We’re Hire to Grow.​ Digital Marketing Apply Now Students Internship Apply Now Jan – March Batch – Closed April – June Batch – Opening Soon Launch Your Career: 90-Day Digital Growth & Marketing Internship Are you ready to bridge the gap between academic theory and real-world business impact? Renton is now accepting applications for our Q2 2026 Student Internship Program (starting from April 2026). This intensive 90-day program is designed for ambitious students looking to master the high-demand skills required to drive digital growth in today’s competitive landscape. The Curriculum: Master the Full Growth Stack Throughout the program, you will gain hands-on experience and mentorship across eight core pillars of modern business: Data Analytics: Turn raw data into actionable business insights. Market & Competitor Analysis: Decode industry trends and stay ahead of the curve. Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Master the art of organic visibility. Strategic Planning: Learn how to build long-term growth roadmaps. Business Communication: Professionalize your verbal and written impact. Customer Cold Outreach: Perfect the “art of the pitch” and lead generation. Paid Advertising: Understand the mechanics of ROI-driven ad campaigns. Business Development: Learn the fundamentals of scaling a brand. Program Details & Eligibility Timeline: 90 Days (Quarter 2, April 2026) Eligibility: Open to all students currently pursuing an Undergraduate (UG) or Postgraduate (PG) degree. Location: [Remote & Hybrid] Status: Admissions Now Open Why Renton? We don’t just assign tasks; we build experts. You will work on live projects, receive direct feedback from industry leaders, and leave with a portfolio that stands out. How to Apply Don’t wait for your career to start after graduation—start it now. Slots for the Q2 cohort are limited. [Apply Now – Button/Link] Form fields: Student’s first and Last name: Contact number Email ID College name Department Semester Your expectation from this internship program?
